name: TaskFlow Pro
summary: Project management tool for remote teams with AI-powered task prioritization.
full_description: TaskFlow Pro is a comprehensive project management solution designed for distributed teams. It uses AI to automatically prioritize tasks based on deadlines, dependencies, and team capacity. Features include Gantt charts, Kanban boards, time tracking, and automated status reports. Integrates with Slack, GitHub, and Jira.

name: CloudDeploy
summary: One-click deployment platform for Python and Node.js applications.
full_description: CloudDeploy simplifies the deployment process for web applications. Deploy Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI) and Node.js apps with a single command. Features include automatic SSL, custom domains, scaling, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring dashboards. Supports PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis databases.

name: InsightAI
summary: Business intelligence dashboard with natural language querying.
full_description: InsightAI transforms raw data into actionable insights. Ask questions in plain English and get instant visualizations. Connects to any SQL database, CSV, or API. Features include automated report generation, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics. No coding required.

name: SecureVault
summary: Enterprise-grade secret management and API key rotation.
full_description: SecureVault provides zero-trust secret management for development teams. Automatically rotate API keys, database credentials, and certificates. Features include audit logs, access policies, compliance reporting, and integration with AWS Secrets Manager and HashiCorp Vault.

name: FormBuilder
summary: Drag-and-drop form builder with conditional logic and integrations.
full_description: FormBuilder lets you create complex forms without code. Features include conditional logic, file uploads, payment collection (Stripe), multi-step forms, and real-time collaboration. Responses sync automatically to Google Sheets, Airtable, or your database.

name: ChatAssist
summary: AI customer support chatbot with knowledge base integration.
full_description: ChatAssist handles customer inquiries 24/7 using AI. Train it on your documentation, FAQs, and support tickets. Features include sentiment analysis, seamless handoff to human agents, multi-language support, and analytics dashboard. Reduces support tickets by up to 60%.

name: DataPipe
summary: ETL pipeline builder for syncing data between SaaS tools.
full_description: DataPipe automates data synchronization between popular SaaS tools. Connect Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, and 50+ other services. Features include real-time syncing, data transformation, error handling, and monitoring. No-code interface with advanced scripting for power users.

name: DesignKit
summary: Collaborative design tool with AI-generated mockups and prototypes.
full_description: DesignKit combines design and prototyping in one tool. Generate UI mockups from text descriptions, create interactive prototypes, and collaborate in real-time. Features include component libraries, design tokens, version history, and developer handoff with code export.

name: PayFlow
summary: Subscription billing and revenue recognition platform.
full_description: PayFlow handles the entire subscription lifecycle. Manage plans, trials, upgrades, and cancellations. Features include automatic invoicing, dunning management, revenue recognition (ASC 606), tax compliance, and detailed financial reporting. Integrates with Stripe, PayPal, and bank accounts.

name: CodeReview AI
summary: Automated code review tool that catches bugs and suggests improvements.
full_description: CodeReview AI analyzes pull requests automatically. It catches security vulnerabilities, performance issues, and code smells. Features include custom rule sets, team coding standards enforcement, and integration with GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket. Supports 15+ programming languages.

name: MailCraft
summary: Email marketing automation with AI-powered subject lines and A/B testing.
full_description: MailCraft makes email marketing effortless. Design beautiful emails with a drag-and-drop editor, segment audiences, and automate campaigns. Features include AI-generated subject lines, predictive send-time optimization, A/B testing, and detailed analytics.

name: APIGateway
summary: Unified API management platform with rate limiting and analytics.
full_description: APIGateway centralizes API management for microservices architectures. Features include rate limiting, authentication, request transformation, caching, and real-time analytics. Supports REST, GraphQL, and gRPC. Includes a developer portal for API documentation.

name: TestBot
summary: Automated QA testing platform with visual regression detection.
full_description: TestBot automates end-to-end testing for web applications. Record tests visually or write them in code. Features include visual regression testing, cross-browser testing, API testing, and CI/CD integration. AI-powered test generation from user flow recordings.

name: MeetSync
summary: AI meeting assistant that transcribes, summarizes, and extracts action items.
full_description: MeetSync records and transcribes meetings automatically. Get AI-generated summaries, action items, and follow-up emails after every call. Features include speaker identification, custom templates, integration with calendar and project tools, and searchable meeting history.

name: InfraStack
summary: Infrastructure-as-code platform for multi-cloud deployments.
full_description: InfraStack provisions and manages cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Features include drift detection, cost optimization, compliance scanning, and environment templating. Supports Terraform, Pulumi, and CloudFormation. Includes a visual infrastructure designer.

name: FeedbackLoop
summary: User feedback collection and feature request voting platform.
full_description: FeedbackLoop helps product teams gather and prioritize user feedback. Embed widgets in your app for in-context feedback. Features include feature request voting boards, NPS surveys, sentiment analysis, and roadmap publishing. Integrates with Jira, Linear, and Notion.

name: InvoiceGen
summary: Automated invoicing and expense tracking for freelancers.
full_description: InvoiceGen simplifies financial management for freelancers and small agencies. Create professional invoices, track expenses, and manage payments. Features include automatic payment reminders, multi-currency support, tax calculations, and financial reports.

name: ContentAI
summary: AI content generation and SEO optimization platform.
full_description: ContentAI creates blog posts, social media content, and marketing copy using AI. Features include SEO optimization, content scoring, plagiarism detection, and multi-language support. Integrates with WordPress, Webflow, and Shopify for direct publishing.

name: StoreKit
summary: E-commerce storefront builder with inventory and order management.
full_description: StoreKit lets you launch an online store in minutes. Features include inventory management, order processing, shipping integration, payment processing, and analytics. Supports physical and digital products. Includes mobile-responsive storefront templates.

name: AuthShield
summary: Zero-config authentication and authorization service.
full_description: AuthShield provides complete authentication infrastructure. Supports email/password, social login, SSO, and MFA out of the box. Features include user management, role-based access control, session management, and compliance with SOC2 and GDPR.
